comparison: DQN and QR-DQN with equal interaction budgets, identical configured episode-density mixtures, rewards, network hidden sizes and optimizer settings; actual policy-dependent experience differs.

speed_control.selection: Independently for mixed DQN and QR mean, choose smallest absolute speed difference from mixed QR lower-quarter at seed 0, density 1; ties prefer lower cap. Collision rates are not selection inputs. Freeze before seeds 1/2.
speed_control.primary_comparison: Mixed QR lower-quarter versus selected DQN governor and same-network QR governor. Report residual speeds and exploratory intervals conditional on selection.
